about.title: About ChampsNote
about.body: ChampsNote is a companion toolkit for Pokémon Champions players. Beyond a calculator, it aims to automatically diagnose team weaknesses and assist with live matchups.
about.dataBody: Game data is based on community-verified public databases (PokéAPI, Pokémon Showdown data). Champions-specific information (regulations, SP rules) is cross-checked against official announcements and trusted sources before inclusion.

common.underConstructionDesc: Features ship in roadmap order. Stay tuned!

dex.loadError: Failed to load data. Please refresh.
dex.rosterNote: The 'In Champions' badge marks Pokémon cross-verified in ranked usage stats as of July 2026. The roster is updated continuously.
dex.matchupNote: Type-based multipliers only. Ability-based immunities (Levitate, Water Absorb, ...) are not applied.
dex.learnsetNote: Union of series data. Verify in-game availability within Champions.

types.fullChartHint: Rows = attacking type, columns = defending type. Scroll horizontally.

calc.title: Damage Calculator
calc.subtitle: Damage calculations on the Pokémon Champions SP system (Level 50)
calc.pickBoth: Pick both attacker and defender to start calculating.
calc.disclaimer: SP maps directly to final stats (1 SP = +1). Engine is @smogon/calc (Gen 9); Champions-specific balance changes are applied once verified. Nature usage requires in-game confirmation.
calc.unknownStatsNote: The opponent's SP investment is hidden in-game. Damage is estimated as a range from 0 investment (max damage) to full defensive investment (min damage).

teams.importHint: Paste a Showdown-format team. Numbers on the SP/EVs line are read as SP (0–32).
teams.speedNote: Each Pokémon's Lv.50 Speed (SP & nature applied). Check who you outspeed.
teams.disclaimer: Teams are auto-saved in your browser (local). Account-synced saving comes in a later phase.
teams.publishUnavailable: Gallery backend is not set up yet

coach.title: Team Auto-Diagnosis
coach.scoreNote: A balance score combining type balance, offensive coverage, and meta answers.
coach.noHoles: No shared weakness holes. Solid typing!
coach.fullCoverage: You can hit every type without resistance.
coach.metaNote: Against the verified Champions meta. Whether you have an offensive (super-effective) or defensive (resist) answer.

sug.weakness: Multiple members are weak to {{types}}. Add a Pokémon that resists/nullifies it.
sug.coverage: No effective way to hit {{types}}. Add coverage moves for those types.
sug.threats: No answer to {{names}}. Consider coverage or a defensive counter.
sug.speed: Nothing at Speed 100+, making it hard to move first. Consider a Scarf or a faster Pokémon.
sug.role: No wall/support role. Add a tank or supporter for balance.

matchup.title: Live Matchup Assistant
matchup.subtitle: Enter the opponent's Pokémon mid-battle for instant lead and threat analysis.
matchup.noTeam: No saved team. Build one first.
matchup.leadsNote: Ordered by favorable offense/defense against the opponent.
matchup.prompt: Add opponent Pokémon to start the analysis.
matchup.disclaimer: Instant type-matchup analysis (moves/abilities not applied). Use the calculator for precise damage.

builds.title: Recommended builds
builds.note: Auto-suggested from base stats and learnset. Use as a starting point and tweak.

reason.physical: Physical attacker leveraging high Attack. SP into Atk and Speed.
reason.fastPhysical: Fast physical sweeper using high Speed to move first.
reason.special: Special attacker on high Sp. Atk. SP into SpA and Speed.
reason.fastSpecial: Fast special sweeper pressuring with first-strike damage.
reason.bulky: Bulky tank using high defenses. SP into HP and defense to endure.

shared.note: This team travels inside the link (no server storage). A public gallery and account saving come in a later phase.

gallery.title: Community samples
gallery.subtitle: Browse teams other trainers shared and import them.
gallery.notReadyNote: The public gallery activates once the D1 backend is set up. For now, share teams with the 'Share link' button in the team builder.
gallery.empty: No public samples yet. Be the first to publish!
gallery.note: Public samples are stored on the server (Cloudflare D1). Reported content is removed.
